system.description:
Whenever a creature is afflicted with the Confused condition, you unravel their mind even further. This skill can also be used as a Trigger Action.

Trigger: You used Whispering Schemes to apply the Confused condition on a target. These effects last as long as the target is afflicted with the Confused condition.

Your target rolls a Magykal Resistance. On failure they are afflicted with the unique Addled condition. The Addled condition causes a creature to no longer regain any expended resources lost via the Confused condition.
